Bulgarian

[edit]
Bulgarian Wikipedia has articles on:
пилот and пилот (морски)
Wikipedia bgWikipedia bg

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French pilote, from Italian piloto.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [piˈɫɔt]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian, l-vocalization):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔt
  • Syllabification(key): пи‧лот

Noun

[edit]

пило́т • (pilót) m

  1. pilot (various senses)
    1. (aviation) pilot (a person who is in charge of the controls of an aircraft)
      Synonyms: лете́ц (letéc), авиа́тор (aviátor)
    2. (motor racing) racing driver
    3. (nautical) pilot (person who steers the ship)
      Synonym: ло́цман (lócman)

Russian

[edit]
Russian Wikipedia has an article on:
пилот
Wikipedia ru

Etymology

[edit]

Several steps omitting from Ancient Greek πηδόν (pēdón) (via Italian pilota and others). Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *ped-.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [pʲɪˈɫot]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ot

Noun

[edit]

пило́т • (pilót) m anim (genitive пило́та, nominative plural пило́ты, genitive plural пило́тов)

  1. (aviation) pilot
  2. (dated, nautical) pilot
  3. (zoology) pilot fish

[edit]

  • навига́тор (navigátor)

[edit]

Related terms

[edit]

  • пилота́ж m (pilotáž)

[edit]
  • → Chechen: пилот (pilot)
  • → Komi-Zyrian: пилот (pilot)
